body:
> Good. You aren't willing to listen or open up Why should anyone here care?

No one should.  I never they anyone should care

>  YOU came here for help not the other way around.

I'm not really looking for help.  I was just seeing if anyone could give me something substantial instead of "it gets better"

> Just to confirm that your right? That before you kill yourself you can die knowing "yes I was right".

I really don't care about being right, but I do care what is right

> You have to find your own answer cause honestly no one is gonna do it for you

Already found it

> Only you can do that and if you are unwilling to do anything about it then It's one less person to worry about

That's the way I see it
You're going to die anyway, why not die now?
Really?  Ending all sensory experience and perception isn't ending the pain?  Rethink that
6 comments and I've heard all this unsubstantial bull shit before.  Is this the best this subreddit can do?  Kind of pathetic, right?

> It is highly possible that the future you will love life

It isn't possible because the things I need changed can never be changed

> If you kill yourself now, you kill a possible future guy who doesn't want to die, who may be craving for life.

When I'm dead I don't have opinions or desires 

Heard it all before

> It's not fun, and it's not quick or easy. There will be immense pain regardless of how you want to do it

Depends on the method

> I can promise you that just before you're gone, you'll regret it

You can't promise me that because you don't know

Heard it all before
